scope: One managed Noto Sans entry and three documentation lines only. No caption text, dimensions, fit limits, app resources or shaping/glyph gate changes.

native_failure_evidence.observed: Native macOS setup RAQM assertion and subsequent audit execute; line278 reports2050 caption strings across50 listings with zero glyph/shaping failures, then seven caption-width failures: six Russian and one Ukrainian. SFNS.ttf is among116 selected fallback strings. This is fitting failure after shaping became available, not recurrence of missing libraqm.

source_and_provenance_assessment: Manifest JSON comparison against HEAD confirms exactly one added notosans family entry; repository pin, manifest metadata and every prior font entry remain unchanged.

Both URLs use the existing exact Google Fonts commit. Font and license were independently fetched from those upstream URLs and byte-compared with the supplied local files; all declared hashes and font size match.

OFL.txt preserves The Noto Project Authors copyright and SIL Open Font License1.1. Existing installer verifies and saves each family's license alongside prepared fonts; no font binary is added to the app/repository by this delta.

caption_font still returns Sora when its exact face covers the whole string. Otherwise managed fonts are considered before operating-system fallbacks; adding a pinned covering family reduces dependence on private macOS system-font metrics without weakening the fit gate.

The new variable font declares wght100..900 with default400 and wdth62.5..100 with default100. Existing fallback selection changes requested weight while retaining the width default; this delta does not narrow fonts or reduce minimum type sizes to force success.

Independent cmap analysis finds no missing glyphs in all123 ru/uk/el caption/preview strings,41 per locale. This is coverage evidence only. It does not prove shaped widths, fallback winner for every font inventory or final typography acceptance.
